timing.en: Passive

effect.en: While this unit contests an objective you control, enemy units cannot finish a charge move within ½" of a model in this unit unless the unmodified charge roll was 7 or more.

timing.en: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **Grimghast Reapers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

units.notes_en: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Any Combat Phase

effect.en: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Spirit Torments.** On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase

declare.en: Pick up to 3 friendly **Chainrasps** units to be the targets.

effect.en: Each target can move 6" but cannot end that move in combat.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, each time this unit makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

timing.en: Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that is within the combat ranges of 5 or more models in this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the target unit has 20 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

effect.en: Pick a friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to enemy units by combat attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit in each phase.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the target is a **HERO**, subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: End of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY HERO** that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's attacks to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **SENTENCED** unit. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
If this unit’s shooting attacks inflicted damage on the target this turn, apply 1 of the following effects. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply 1 of the following effects:

***Phantasmal Solvent:*** If the target has a Move characteristic of'-', inflict 6 mortal damage on the target.
***Acidic Fug:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
***Fling Concoctions:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Hurled Vial this phase but all attacks made by this unit this phase must target that enemy unit.
***Choking Vapours:*** If the target is a **WIZARD**, subtract 1 from its power level until the start of your next turn.
***Fear-laced Hallucinogen:*** If the target is a **PRIEST**, remove D3 ritual points from it.
***Unholy Prescription:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

units.notes_en: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

effect.en: If a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability. If the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

name.ja: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

timing.en: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

effect.en: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

timing.en: Your Hero Phase

declare.en: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• If the target was not set up this turn and is not in combat, it can move up to 3". It cannot move into combat.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief**, then pick up to 3 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be a target of this ability more than once per phase.

effect.en:
For each target:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (D3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of this terrain feature.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

effect.en: Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 3" of a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all terrain features and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit charged this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.

This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

**Cover, Impassable**

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: If this unit is contesting an objective, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add a number equal to the roll to this unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.

effect.en:
You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the enemy target that do not target this unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls for the enemy target’s attacks.
• If you picked a friendly target, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy target.

units.notes_en: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Each time a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, if all of its attacks target the same **SENTENCED** enemy unit, that friendly unit's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for that **FIGHT** ability.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and the target has the **SENTENCED** keyword for the rest of the battle.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Friendly **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY HEROES** have **WARD (4+)** while they are wholly within this unit’s combat range.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: Each time a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.

timing.en: Passive

effect.en: While there are any visible friendly **Myrmourn Banshees** units within this unit’s combat range, ignore positive modifiers to the control scores of enemy units within 12" of this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
